description: F4 freeway : Mays Hill - Prospect : working paper 2 : traffic model is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by NSW Government. This Working Paper describes and compares the seven alternative schemes investigated using the Department o f Main Roads (DMR) 'TRANPLAN' traffic assignment model. A 2011 trip table (developed from the 1981 trip table) was assigned to these schemes and the resulting volumes generated by the model were compared. Coverage: NSW Government.
